Keep the Heroes Out!
games.comment:
Excellent production, but a disappointing experience.

We've played two games with two players, both using the first scenario. The first, on Family difficulty, was so easy and lacking in tension that we gave up at the end of the first wave out of sheer boredom. In the second game, using different monster clans and Challenge difficulty, the exact opposite happened: the heroes overwhelmed us so quickly that we barely had a chance to develop our decks or come up with any meaningful strategy.

The difficulty gap between these two levels feels excessive. Also, despite the asymmetric clans and the potential of the deck-building mechanics, we found surprisingly few genuinely interesting decisions to make.

It's a real shame, because the production quality is fantastic, the artwork is beautiful, and the theme is wonderfully original. Maybe it gets better with more plays, but so far it has left us quite disappointed and with little desire to try again.
